description: Use this when you need the person’s cases, or the id of a case you do not have. Input: optional `limit` and `cursor`. Returns the cases of the key’s organization and mode (test or live), newest first, a page at a time, each with its `state` and `nextAction`, and `nextCursor` for the next page (null on the last). Do not use this when you already have the case id (use evictions_get_case). Needs the person’s account: sign-in or an API key.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the page before, for the next page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: How many to return, at most 100. The default is 20.

name: evictions_list_cases
title: List cases
